facts.text: Bowdoin requires all students to live in college-owned housing for their first two undergraduate years.

sources.title: Residential Life Policies | Bowdoin College
sources.quote: Students are required to live in college housing during their first two years at Bowdoin. Juniors and seniors wishing to live off campus are required to enter the Off-Campus Housing Lottery to receive approval to live in off-campus housing.
